Commentary.Commentary: Right. 8 overs left in the day but don't think we will get all 8. We would be lucky to get 5. Australia will hope for at least a wicket or two while India will aim to knock these off without any damage. The players come out to the middle. Prithvi Shaw and Mayank Agarwal are the openers for India. It is Mitchell Starc with the new strawberry. The man on a pair, Shaw, will face. Here we go...

Sensational bowling performance from India. Why need batters to score 400-500 when you don't allow oppositions to score even 200? Jokes apart, except for the first 7-8 overs with the new ball this afternoon, where they wasted and Australia did not take any advantage, they were phenomenal. Mohammed Shami went wicketless but ironically, it was Shami who changed the proceedings. He showed the right lengths to bowl and Bumrah and Umesh duly followed. The duo shared 5 wickets between themselves but when do you a see a spinner take 4 wickets in the first innings - either in or outside India? Bravo R Ashwin, a sensational display, one which Australia would never have expected. They prepared for Bumrah and Shami, but Umesh and Ashwin devoured them.

A sorry batting card for Australia. No David Warner, means that they struggle at the top. And add to it, Steven Smith flops, which means the spinal cord is cut off. Marnus Labuschagne was the only one who showed some resistance in the top half of the batting order and that too, after getting numerous chances. Australia can credit themselves for minimizing the lead though, as at 111/7, from staring at a lead in excess of 120, they have got it down to a shade over 50. Gritty knock from captain Tim Paine amid useful stands with the bowlers.

Hmmm.... a lead of 53! No so great under normal circumstances but when a team has made just under 250, they will take it with open hands. The Indian captain is looking visibly happy and not surprisingly. It is a matter of a watchful 25-30 minutes for tonight before bedding in the whole of tomorrow.

We are back for the final session of Day 2. The Indian players are out in the middle. Marnus Labuschagne and Tim Paine will resume their innings for Australia. Ravichandran Ashwin will start the proceedings for the final session of Day 2.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

With the lights coming in later on in the innings, batting can become quite hard and Indians will be looking to wrap things up towards the end of the day. Who comes out on top? Will the duo of Labuschagne and Paine show resilience and fight it out till the end of the day or will the bowling attack of India make small work of the remaining batters? All the answers will be found after the Tea Break. Join us on the other side.

It was Ashwin who has ran riot all over the Aussie middle order as since he was introduced into the attack, he has picked up 3 wickets to his name. He removed the dangerous Smith and then kept at it and then sent Head and Green back into the shed as well. The hosts still have Labuschagne and skipper, Paine out in the middle and will be banking on them to continue their anchoring for as long as they can.

India will definitely be the happier side heading into the Tea break. This is just what they would have wanted when they came out after the Dinner break, that they could restrict the run flow and also scalp the wickets at regular intervals and they have done just that.

Travis Head is the new batsman in. Also, Umesh Yadav is back into the attack. His figures so far read 6-4-6-0.

OUT! CAUGHT! The change to bring on Ashwin works for India as he gets rid of the dangerous Smith! Great bowling by Ravichandran and he grabs a wicket and breaks this partnership! Floated on off, Smith prods forward looking for the defensive stroke but the ball kisses the outside edge and goes towards the first slip, where Rahane gets low and takes a good catch. Smith goes without doing a lot of damage as he has scored only the solitary run.
Loopy delivery on middle, Smith defends it off the front foot.
Floated ball on off, Smith keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on middle, Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Smith survives and the Australians can breathe a sigh of relief! Floated on the pads, Labuschagne tucks it to square leg and the fielder there does well to run and collect the ball. Smith is already out of the crease by a lot, looking for the single. Marnus sends him back. The throw is towards Ashwin, who collects the ball and whips the bails off as Smith dives in looking to make it in. The third umpire is called into play and replays show that the dive put in by Smith was enough for him to stay out in the middle.
An appeal for run out! Steven Smith is the man in question.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Labuschagne flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Some spin finally for India as Ravichandran Ashwin is introduced into the attack.
Full delivery on off, Smith plays it to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Labuschagne shoulders arms to this one.
Full delivery on middle, Labuschagne flicks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length on off, Marnus defends it to covers.
Length delivery on off, Labuschagne pushes it to covers.
Bouncer on off, Labuschagne ducks under it.
Bouncer on middle, Smith does well to duck under it.
Back of a length on off, Smith offers a solid defense on this one.
Good length delivery on off, Smith defends it off the back foot.
Bouncer on off, Smith does well to duck under it.
Length ball on middle, Smith looks to flick but misses to get hit on the body.
Length delivery on off, Smith defends it back towards the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Length delivery outside off, Marnus shoulders arms to this one.
Good length ball outside off, Labuschagne defends it to covers.
Outside off, Labuschagne offers no shot to this one.
Good length delivery on off, Labuschagne defends it off the back foot.
Short delivery on middle, Labuschagne pulls it to mid-wicket.

EDGED...but it does not carry! Good stuff from Bumrah. Creating chances to send the batters back to the hut. On a good length on off, Smith looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes towards the slip cordon but it does not carry as it lands in between both the slip fielders. What an eventful over.
BEATEN! On a good length on off, Smith looks to defend but he misses it altogether.

IN THE AIR...DROPPED! What a big chance this was to get rid of Labuschagne but Shaw has made a complete mess of this and Marnus gets his second life. On a shorter length on off, Labuschagne pulls this one but it goes off the top edge and lobs towards mid-wicket. Shaw backtracks and looks to scalp this one but he is not quite in control of it and it pops out of his hands. A single taken. Kohli does not look like a happy camper there. He has every right to be annoyed, this should have been taken.
On a good length outside off, Marnus lets this one be.
Outside off, stroked to point.
Back of a length delivery on off, Marnus blocks this one towards the mid on region.
Full delivery on middle, Smith defends it to mid on.
Back of a length on middle, Smith defends it to mid-wicket.
Short ball on middle, Smith defends it towards the leg side.
Length delivery on middle, Smith defends it to short mid-wicket.
Bouncer on off, Smith does well to duck under it.
Length ball on off, Smith defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery on off, Labuschagne defends it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Marnus defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery on off, Labuschagne defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length on middle, Labuschagne offers a solid defense on this one.
Length ball on off, Labuschagne blocks it off the front foot.
EDGY FOUR! Good length delivery on off, Labuschagne looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes between third slip and gully towards third man for a boundary.
Who will partner Shami with the ball? It is Jasprit Bumrah who is handed the ball.
Length delivery on off, Smith defends it off the front foot.
Length ball on middle, Smith blocks it well.
Back of a length on off, Smith defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery on middle, Labuschagne flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Marnus defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Labuschagne keeps it out.

We are back for the second session of Day 2! The batters for the hosts, Marnus Labuschagne and Steven Smith stride out into the middle. Mohammed Shami to continue after the break. 5-0-19-0 are his figures so far.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Right then, something to cheer about for both the teams. India will be hoping to continue more of the same and their counter-parts will be looking at Smith and Labuschagne to anchor and take them to safer shores. Which team comes out on top in the second session? Join us as we will be back shortly.

Not the start that India would have wanted to Day 2 but just the finish to the first session that they were aiming for, they have put the Australians on the back foot due to Bumrah's bowling in the last half hour. They were poor with the bat as they lost all their remaining wickets for just 11 runs. They started off nicely with the ball and have done extremely well towards the end of the session to send the openers back to the hut and will look to continue the same.

The Aussies started off in some fashion as they bundled out the remaining batters of India for just 11 runs as Cummins and Starc shared the four wickets amongst themselves. They started off slow with the bat but they seemed to have lost their way as Wade and Burns were sent packing by Bumrah. The positive thing for the hosts is that they have Smith and Labuschagne out in the middle and they will be roaring to play against this Indian bowling attack.

India will be the happier side heading into the Dinner break. They have just changed gears in the last half hour of play and Bumrah has done well to get rid of the openers of the Aussies. The hosts will be pleased as this break has come at the right time for them.
Short delivery down the leg side, Smith does well to duck under it. THAT WILL BE DINNER ON DAY 2!
Full delivery on off, Smith drives it to mid off.
Outside off, Smith offers no shot to this one.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Smith looks to defend but misses it.
Good length delivery outside off, Smith shoulders arms to this one.
Back of a length outside off, Smith offers no shot to this one.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Short of a length delivery on middle, Labuschagne looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes towards fine leg where Bumrah tries to take the catch but spills it and concedes a boundary. That should have been taken but maybe Bumrah was worried about where the boundary ropes were and lost his composure.
Length ball on middle, Smith flicks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Marnus looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Good length delivery outside off, Labuschagne offers no shot to this one.
Length ball on middle, Marnus looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Back of a length delivery on off, Labuschagne keeps it out.
Steven Smith is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Another batter falls and it is India's gun bowler, Bumrah who has struck again for the visitors! Burns is the man who has departed after playing a patient, slow knock of 8 runs from 41 balls. Bumrah dishes a yorker length ball on middle and leg, Burns looks to work this to the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. An excited appeal from the Indian players and the umpire agrees raising his finger. Burns goes for the review. Ultra Edge shows that there is no bat involved. Ball Tracker comes in and it is Umpire's Call in favour of India again and Burns has to go back. They retain this review as well but they have lost both their openers in quick succession.
Review time! An appeal for lbw! Joe Burns is the man in question. Snicko shows there is no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call.
Good length delivery on off, Burns defends it off the front foot.
Bouncer on middle, Burns does well to duck under it.
Back of a length on middle, Burns tucks it towards short fine leg.
Length delivery outside off, Burns offers no shot to this one.
Good length delivery on off, Burns defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length on middle, Labuschagne flicks it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Length delivery on leg, Labuschagne flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.

FOUR! Good length delivery on off, Labuschagne looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a boundary. Agarwal does well to chase after this and pull it back but the umpires want to have a check and they decide that it will be a boundary.
Good length ball outside off, Labuschagne offers no shot to this one.
Back of a length outside off, Labuschagne shoulders arms to this one.
Length delivery on off, Burns looks to defend but gets an inside edge. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single.
Length ball outside off, Marnus offers no shot to this one.
Outside off, Labuschagne leaves it alone.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length delivery on off, Labuschagne looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes between the keeper's dive and first slip towards third man for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Marnus blocks it off the back foot.
Length delivery on off, Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Who will come in now? Marnus Labuschagne is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Bumrah picks up the first wicket of the game and Wade walks back to the hut now! Australia have started off slowly but their opening pair cannot continue on. A slow innings from Wade as he made 8 runs from 51 balls. Good length ball on middle from around the wicket, Wade looks to push this to the leg side and misses to get rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire obliges raising his finger. Wade has a talk with his partner and goes for the review. Ultra Edge rolls in and there is no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that this will be umpire's call and Wade has to walk back now. Australia retain their review though.
Shortish on middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Burns pushes it towards point and will pick up a couple.
Outside off, left alone.
Short ball down the leg side, Burns lets this one be as well.
A mild appeal for LBW but turned down! Full and around off, Burns looks to defend and does. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Short ball down the leg side, Burns lets it be.
Good length ball on off, Wade looks to block this one out but misses and gets hit on the body.
Shortish on the body, Wade looks to evade it but does not do so cleanly. It hits him on the body. That would have hurt.
On the pads, worked to short mid-wicket.
Bouncer on middle, Wade gets under this one.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball on off, Wade hops and blocks this one out.
Good fielding by Yadav! A back of a length ball outside off, Wade punches this one towards point and Yadav does well to dive and stop this one. Keeps it down just to a single.
Good length ball on off, guided to gully.
Bouncer on off, Wade sits under this one.
Short of a length ball outside off, Wade shoulders arms to this one.
Outside off, left alone by Wade.
On off, pushed to covers.
On the pads, tucked through square leg for one. They think about the second run but do not go for it. Just a single.
Bouncer on middle, Wade sits under this one.
On a length on off, pushed to Bumrah at mid off.
Outside off, guided to gully.
Short of a length and on off, Wade pushes this one towards point. Wade says no run straightaway. The communication between these two has been good so far.
Outside off, Matthew does not want to have a poke at this one.
Full on middle, tucked to short mid-wicket. A good over from Shami. Just 2 runs.
On off, pushed towards the man at mid on.
On a good length on off, Burns pushes this to point.
On off, pushed towards covers.
Full on middle, worked through square leg for a brace.
Good length ball on off, defended to the leg side.
On off, pushed to point.
Short of a length on middle, Wade looks to evade it but does not completely as the ball hits his back. That would have stung.
Back of a length and on off, Wade pushes it to the off side.
Outside off, left alone.
Short ball on off, Wade pulls but it comes off the lower part of the blade and goes to the man at square leg.
On off, pushed to the leg side.
Full and around off, pushed to mid on.
Outside off, left alone.
LEG BYE! On the pads, Wade tickles it towards fine leg for one. The umpire signals this as a leg bye.

A tame appeal for LBW but turned down. A back of a length ball on off and middle, Wade looks to play at this but misses to get hit high on the pads. The players appeal but no says the umpire. Height could have been an issue there.
Full and around off, Burns pushes this to the off side and takes a quick run.
Burns is a typical Test match player. You keep bowling length balls outside off and he makes a leave.
A dot to end! Wade comes on the front foot and then shoulders arms to this length ball outside off.
Now Wade does not play at this length ball which is way outside off.
On a length and around off, Wade taps it to cover-point and calls a loud 'no run' to his partner.
Full and around off, Wade strokes it to the man at covers.
Length and outside off, Wade does not fiddle with it.
Length ball angled into off, Wade blocks it to the leg side.
Length and outside off, Burns lets it be.

That was nasty! Short and aimed at the batsman, Burns lines up for the pull but then decides to let it go through. Though he is late on it as the ball takes the chest, then the grille and lobs towards the slip cordon. The fielders claim a catch but nothing from the umpire and India too do not review.
Another length ball outside off and Burns makes another leave.
Length delivery outside off, Burns makes a leave this time. With the new ball, you need to make the batsmen play.
BURNS IS ALSO UP AND RUNNING! Full and slanting on the pads, Burns flicks it towards deep square leg and takes a brace to open his account.
On a length and around off, Wade taps it towards short cover and takes a quick single.
Outside off, left alone. Burns has faced 13 balls but has still not opened his account.
On the pads, tucked towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Wade and Australia open their account in some fashion! A back of a length ball outside off, width offered to Wade, he punches this one through the cover region for a boundary.
On middle, blocked out.
Back of a length ball on middle, Wade fends this one out. Says no run instantly. Australia still have not opened their account in this innings.
On the body, no space awarded to Wade, he looks to push this to the on side but misses to get hit on the body.
Yes, a dot on the last ball will mean that this is the fourth maiden in a row for India. A length ball outside off, Burns does not have a poke at this.
Outside off, Burns does not engage at this one too. Fourth maiden in a row incoming?
Short of a length outside off, Joe raIses his blade and lets this one pass to Saha.
On off, pushed towards mid on.
Outside off, left alone.
EDGY! Short of a length on off, Burns looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes towards gully.
Three maidens in a row! Back of a length on middle, Wade looks to fend it away but misses to get hit high on the thigh pad. A good start by Umesh.
Another ball which is behind the good length on off, tapped towards point. Wade says 'NO RUNNN' straightaway.
Outside off, Wade has no issues in leaving this one alone.
Back of a length ball on off, Wade nudges this to the leg side.
Short of a length on middle, Wade looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses to get hit high on the thigh pad.
BEATEN! Good delivery from Umesh! On a good length on off, Wade looks to block this one out but the ball whizzes past the outside edge into the mitts of Saha.
A maiden for Bumrah too! Length and around off, Burns shoulders arms to it.
On a length and around off, Joe blocks it with soft hands and right under his eyes.
Now Bumrah bowls it very wide of off stump, Burns won't play at it.
SO CLOSE TO THE EDGE! Bumrah bowls one on a length and around off, the ball just about nips away as Burns has a tentative poke at it. The ball though sneaks past the outside edge.
Another length ball in that channel outside off, Burns is happy to leave it.
Length ball outside off, Burns makes a leave.
Who will it be with the ball partnering Yadav? It will be Jasprit Bumrah.
A dot to end! A maiden from Umesh! Full and wide outside off, Matthew is happy to let that pass.
Length and outside off, Wade makes a leave this time.
Wade is being too tentative here. Another length ball around off, Wade once again goes chasing the ball but is lucky not to edge it behind.

We are all in readiness to begin the Australian batting for the first innings. Their openers, Joe Burns and Matthew Wade stride out into the middle. The players of India are in a huddle and Virat Kohli is imparting some final words of wisdom before the players spread out to their respective positions. Umesh Yadav with the ball first up for India.
BEATEN! Another length ball that leaves the left hander there, Wade looks to have a poke at it but fails to lay bat on ball. It misses the outside edge this time once again.
Length ball around off, Wade makes a leave now.
Nice start from Yadav! Pitches it in the channel around off, Wade looks to push it to the off side but gets beaten.
